name: Independent and nondenominational churches

facts.value: Christians whose church structures, beliefs and practices are claimed to be independent of historic organized Christianity. They include many African independent denominations, unregistered Chinese churches and U.S. nondenominational churches.

citations.excerpt: Independent Christians have developed ecclesial structures, beliefs and practices that are claimed to be independent of historic, organized Christianity.

Independent Christians include denominations in sub-Saharan Africa that identify as independent from historically Protestant denominations, churches in China that are not affiliated with official religious associations and nondenominational churches in the United States.
